standard_prerequisites.name: Extensionality under substitution for formulas
standard_prerequisites.use: Core step in both items: Sat(M, subst(A,t',x))[s] iff Sat(M,A)[s with x := value of t'].

standard_prerequisites.name: Quantifier clause for variable assignments
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the closed-term instance to the assignment-wise quantifier clauses.

standard_prerequisites.name: Sentences are assignment-independent
standard_prerequisites.use: prvAll final step: A(t) is a sentence, so satisfaction drops the assignment.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 2289-2296), two tagitems: prvEx - A(t) entails exists x A(x); prvAll - forall x A(x) entails A(t), for closed t and single-free-variable A(x).

prvEx (lines 2298-2306): from Sat(M, A(t)) pick s with s(x)=value of t; A(t) is a sentence so satisfaction holds under s; prop:ext-formulas converts to Sat(M, A(x))[s]; prop:sat-quant gives Sat(M, exists x A(x)).

prvAll (lines 2307-2314): from Sat(M, forall x A(x)) the assignment clause gives Sat(M, A(x))[s] for s(x)=value of t; prop:ext-formulas converts back to A(t); prop:sentence-sat-true drops the assignment since A(t) is a sentence.
proof_roadmap: prvEx: assignment to the term value, extensionality, existential clause.
prvAll: universal clause, extensionality back, sentence independence.
